node reach: transition on line_status unclear with reach.total_turns above 1, max_node_turns as fallback
node reach: no account data, no verify_identity tool
tool schedule_callback: pre hook blocks anything outside the window computed in brain; transitions on its success and failure counters
tool verify_identity: pre hook blocks phone_last4 before the date of birth passed and rewrites a numbers-only date as day, month, year into YYYY-MM-DD
tool verify_identity: post hook turns the bank's answer into the next step; identity transition on wrong_answers_left 0; brain farewell names app or branch
node brain: decline_count, human_count and notalk counters fed by the id_intent and reply enums; allowed_queue opens the transfer
node brain: step() state machine on the reply, date_said, amount_said and about slots; it holds every counter and writes the one offer the model may make
tool create_promise: pre hook sends only products confirmed in the brain confirm phase, with amount and date from code, never twice; the wording is in the brain step text
tool transfer_to_agent: pre hook sends only the queue the brain step opened (allowed_queue); hardship branch in brain comes before persuasion
tool create_promise: post hook counts failures per product and stops after two; brain farewell says recorded and the text-message sentence only after a recorded promise
node brain: reply enum paid or dispute closes the product with that reason
tool add_note: pre hook sends only notes planned by brain, never for one product or on a transfer, reason from code
node brain: finish branch sets outcome and reason; tool close_call runs at end_of_call
node end: terminal spoken_message from the brain farewell
